name: Varney Lake
source:
In the hot summer of 1954, Jimmy, Doug and Christine are spending their fourth vacation together at Varney Lake. Teenage crushes, pranks and card tricks, long days of adventure, a pipe dream of saving the local drive-in from demolition; they're kids, coming of age.

Until they Find the Vampire.

1981. Lou Hill, paranormal investigator, has a lead on a mind-blowing case. Will he be able to convince the now 40-something trio to tell him the truth about that summer? Do they even know themselves?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1954年的炎夏，吉米、道格和克里斯汀将第四次一同来到Varney Lake度假。他们正值青春期，有懵懂的爱恋、恶作剧、纸牌戏法，以及漫长的冒险时光；他们还梦想拯救当地那家即将拆除的汽车电影院。他们不过是一群正在成长的孩子。

直到他们发现了吸血鬼。

1981年。超自然现象调查员卢·希尔得到了一条惊人的案件线索。他能否说服如今已年过四十的三人，讲出那个夏天的真相？他们自己又是否知道真相？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933180/]Steam[/url]]
